race.comment: Deep race. LOCKYER (3) is airborne and finds another suitable race to continue on his merry way. Is a track and trip specialist, adding to the record last time with a dominant win where he was doing his best work late. Keeps Pozman's 3kg claim to get him in a treat at the weights and looks the one to beat again. CUTEPI (7) bounced back sharply to form last start when letting down strongly to win a CL3 at the Sunshine Coast. Has more to offer and if the pace is genuine she can cause a big scare. STARMAN (11) has built nicely into this campaign and rates a live chance this time despite not winning for a very long time. Is drawn favourably down in the weights and should be in this for a long way. ZOUPER FUND (1) also hasn't won for a while but is ticking going well and gets help under the big weight with Younberry reuniting. Draws the A1 and is more than capable of taking this out.
